newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares close firmer, seen range-bound.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares close firmer, seen range-bound.

text.p: 1220 GMT - Austrian shares close firmer but volume remains scant with little buying interest, traders said.
ATX blue-chip index seen stuck within its tight 1,010 to 1,040-point range but traders said any pick-up in demand could suddenly drive the "very illiquid" market higher.
* ATX index up 5.52 points or 0.54 percent at 1,036.02
* September ATX future up 9.2 points at 1036.2
* 15 ATX shares up, 5 down, one unchanged
* Leading gainer Leykam, up 2.9 percent at 300, with Lenzing the leading decliner, down 1.66 percent at 650
